description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface and serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility to facilitate customizable logging within a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility, forwarding log messages to the next node in the logging chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specific priority, tag, and optional throwable, then passes the log to the next node if present.
